Title: Attempt to record an expense with no source selected
Preconditions: User is logged in and on the 'Add Transaction' screen with an expense type selected
Steps:
1. Enter a valid amount (e.g., 500). 2. Leave the 'Source' field unselected. 3. Tap the 'Save' button.

Test Data: Amount: 500, Type: Expense, Source: (none selected)
Expected Result: The system displays an error message 'Source is required' and does not save the transaction. The 'Save' button remains disabled until a source is selected.

Title: Attempt to record a transaction with a negative amount
Preconditions: User is logged in and on the 'Add Transaction' screen
Steps:
1. Select 'Income' as the transaction type. 2. Enter a negative amount (e.g., -100). 3. Select a valid source (e.g., 'Bank'). 4. Tap the 'Save' button.

Test Data: Amount: -100, Type: Income, Source: Bank
Expected Result: The system displays an error message 'Amount must be positive' and does not save the transaction. The amount field is highlighted in red.

Title: Attempt to record an expense exceeding the available balance in the selected source
Preconditions: User has a bank balance of 1000 and is on the 'Add Transaction' screen
Steps:
1. Select 'Expense' as the transaction type. 2. Enter an amount (e.g., 1500) greater than the available bank balance. 3. Select 'Bank' as the source. 4. Tap the 'Save' button.

Test Data: Amount: 1500, Type: Expense, Source: Bank, Available Balance: 1000
Expected Result: The system displays an amber warning banner 'This transaction exceeds your available balance. Record as Credit/Loan?' and changes the call-to-action button to 'Record as Credit/Loan'. The transaction is not saved as a regular expense.

Title: Attempt to record a withdrawal exceeding the available bank balance
Preconditions: User has a bank balance of 1000 and is on the 'Add Transaction' screen
Steps:
1. Select 'Withdrawal' as the transaction type. 2. Enter an amount (e.g., 1500) greater than the available bank balance. 3. Tap the 'Save' button.

Test Data: Amount: 1500, Type: Withdrawal, Available Balance: 1000
Expected Result: The system displays an error message 'Withdrawal amount cannot exceed bank balance' and does not save the transaction. The amount field is highlighted in red.

Title: Attempt to record a transaction with a non-numeric amount
Preconditions: User is logged in and on the 'Add Transaction' screen
Steps:
1. Select 'Income' as the transaction type. 2. Enter a non-numeric value (e.g., 'abc') in the amount field. 3. Select a valid source (e.g., 'Bank'). 4. Tap the 'Save' button.

Test Data: Amount: abc, Type: Income, Source: Bank
Expected Result: The system displays an error message 'Amount must be a valid number' and does not save the transaction. The amount field is highlighted in red.

Title: Attempt to record a transaction with an invalid source for the selected type
Preconditions: User is logged in and on the 'Add Transaction' screen
Steps:
1. Select 'Withdrawal' as the transaction type. 2. Manually enter an invalid source (e.g., 'Cash') that is not allowed for withdrawals. 3. Enter a valid amount (e.g., 500). 4. Tap the 'Save' button.

Test Data: Amount: 500, Type: Withdrawal, Source: Cash
Expected Result: The system displays an error message 'Invalid source for withdrawal' and does not save the transaction. The source field is highlighted in red.

Title: Attempt to edit a transaction to exceed the available balance without credit flag
Preconditions: User has an existing expense transaction of 500 from 'Bank' with a current bank balance of 1000
Steps:
1. Open the existing transaction for editing. 2. Change the amount to 1500 (exceeding the available balance). 3. Ensure the 'Record as Credit/Loan' option is unchecked. 4. Tap the 'Save' button.

Test Data: Original Amount: 500, New Amount: 1500, Type: Expense, Source: Bank, Available Balance: 1000
Expected Result: The system displays an amber warning banner 'This transaction exceeds your available balance. Record as Credit/Loan?' and changes the call-to-action button to 'Record as Credit/Loan'. The transaction is not saved as a regular expense.

Title: Attempt to record a transaction with no title
Preconditions: User is logged in and on the 'Add Transaction' screen
Steps:
1. Leave the 'Title' field empty. 2. Enter a valid amount (e.g., 500). 3. Select a valid type (e.g., 'Expense') and source (e.g., 'Bank'). 4. Tap the 'Save' button.

Test Data: Title: (empty), Amount: 500, Type: Expense, Source: Bank
Expected Result: The system displays an error message 'Title is required' and does not save the transaction. The title field is highlighted in red.

Title: Attempt to record a transaction with a future date
Preconditions: User is logged in and on the 'Add Transaction' screen
Steps:
1. Enter a valid title (e.g., 'Test'). 2. Enter a valid amount (e.g., 500). 3. Select a date in the future (e.g., tomorrow). 4. Select a valid type (e.g., 'Expense') and source (e.g., 'Bank'). 5. Tap the 'Save' button.

Test Data: Title: Test, Amount: 500, Date: Tomorrow, Type: Expense, Source: Bank
Expected Result: The system displays an error message 'Date cannot be in the future' and does not save the transaction. The date field is highlighted in red.
